verdict.rationale: Convex documents its own Convex Auth library, which builds sign-up/sign-in flows using social identity providers, one-time email/SMS codes, or passwords, so both email/password and social OAuth are covered first-party. It also documents integrations with Clerk, WorkOS AuthKit, Auth0, and any OIDC provider. However, the docs scope Convex Auth to client-side React and React Native apps, and nothing shows the setup actually takes minutes. missing for 10: evidence of a minutes-level setup flow, Convex Auth support beyond React/React Native, hands-on or independent corroboration.
